📺 9-1-1 (2018–Present)

9-1-1 follows the courageous firefighters, police officers, paramedics, and emergency dispatchers of Los Angeles as they respond to some of the city’s most dangerous and unpredictable emergencies. From devastating fires and shocking accidents to dramatic rescues and life-threatening situations, the first responders must remain calm under pressure while risking their lives to protect others. Led by characters like Bobby Nash, Athena Grant, and Evan “Buck” Buckley, the team also faces personal struggles, complicated relationships, and emotional challenges outside their demanding jobs. Filled with intense action, unforgettable rescues, and heartfelt moments, 9-1-1 explores bravery, sacrifice, friendship, family, and the extraordinary dedication of everyday heroes.

🎭 Genre: Action • Drama • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 7.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 42 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Ryan Murphy, Brad Falchuk & Tim Minear

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu in the United States. Availability varies by region.
